Designed to move everything forward.

Apple Aether brings electric performance, intelligent control, and a new sense of calm to the road.

Take a closer look at Aether.

Seamless design. Apple Aether is sculpted as one continuous surface, with refined aerodynamics to help it reach an incredibly low drag coefficiency.
Space, reimagined. A calm interior where controls appear only when needed, and every surface is designed to reduce noise, distraction, and effort.
The interface that waits. Voice, touch, gesture, and spatial controls work together so information appears at the right time, in the right place.
Intelligence, built in. Apple Aether continuously understands its surroundings, adapts to you, and works seamlessly across your Apple ecosystem.
Confidence everywhere. Advanced sensing and intelligent assistance help every drive feel more aware, more responsive, and more at ease.
Power, without the pause. Fast charging, smart scheduling, and route-aware energy guidance keep Aether ready when you are.
